data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER bk_settings_ins AFTER INSERT ON settings
WHEN (NEW."key" IN ('locale', 'currencyCode', 'firstDayOfWeek', 'dateFormat', 'themeMode', 'selectedTheme', 'fontSize', 'enabledModules', 'moduleOrder', 'notificationsEnabled', 'budgetAlertsEnabled', 'habitRemindersEnabled', 'dailySummaryTime', 'homeComingSoonDismissed') OR NEW."key" LIKE 'module.%')
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO settings ("key", value, updated_at)
    VALUES ('dataChangeCounter', '1', CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000)
    ON CONFLICT ("key") DO UPDATE SET value = CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") BETWEEN 1 AND 40), "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("color_hex" LIKE '#%'), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TRIGGER bk_accounts_ins AFTER INSERT ON accounts BEGIN INSERT INTO settings ("key", value, updated_at) VALUES ('dataChangeCounter', '1', CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO UPDATE SET value = CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1;END

CREATE TRIGGER bk_accounts_upd AFTER UPDATE ON accounts BEGIN INSERT INTO settings ("key", value, updated_at) VALUES ('dataChangeCounter', '1', CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO UPDATE SET value = CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999900), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL CHECK("note" IS NULL OR LENGTH("note") <= 200), "frequency" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("interval" >= 1), "anchor_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_run_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("end_at" IS NULL OR "end_at" >= "anchor_at"), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_minor" BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999900), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id), "payment_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL CHECK("note" IS NULL OR LENGTH("note") <= 200), "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "receipt_path" TEXT NULL, "recurring_rule_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_rules (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER bk_transactions_ins AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO settings ("key", value, updated_at) VALUES ('dataChangeCounter', '1', CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000) ON CONFLICT ("key") DO UPDATE SET value = CAST(value AS INTEGER) + 1;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "habits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_value" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL CHECK("unit" IS NULL OR LENGTH("unit") <= 20), "schedule_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekdays_mask" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekdays_mask" BETWEEN 0 AND 127), "times_per_week" INTEGER NULL CHECK("times_per_week" IS NULL OR "times_per_week" BETWEEN 1 AND 6), "reminder_times" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "remind_only_if_not_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_only_if_not_done" IN (0, 1)), "start_date_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "freezes_available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("freezes_available" BETWEEN 0 AND 2), "celebrated_milestones" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("celebrated_milestones" BETWEEN 0 AND 63), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 40), CHECK ((kind = 0 AND target_value = 1) OR (kind = 1 AND target_value BETWEEN 1 AND 9999)), CHECK (start_date_key GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]'));
